name: Timer
author: ViberDock
description: A countdown timer, a Pomodoro timer (work and breaks in rounds), a stopwatch or a countdown to a date, with a progress ring or bar. A click opens Start, Pause, Reset and presets; a middle click starts or pauses; the wheel over a stopped countdown changes it by a minute. A banner (with a sound, if you like) says when it ends, also while the dock is hidden. It keeps counting across a restart of the dock.

settings.label: Kind
settings.description: What it counts: down from a length, Pomodoro rounds of work and breaks, up from zero, or down to a date. Each kind keeps its own state.

settings.label: Length
settings.description: How long the countdown runs. The wheel over the stopped timer changes it for this run. Default: 5 minutes.

settings.label: Presets
settings.description: Up to six lengths in minutes for the popup's buttons, separated by commas. A click on one starts it.

settings.label: Work
settings.description: The length of a work period. Default: 25 minutes.

settings.label: Short break
settings.description: The break after each work period but the last of a set. Default: 5 minutes.

settings.label: Long break
settings.description: The break after the last work period of a set. Default: 15 minutes.

settings.label: Work periods in a set
settings.description: How many work periods come before the long break. Default: 4.

settings.label: Start the next period by itself
settings.description: When a period ends the next one starts at once. Off: it waits for Start.

settings.label: Date and time
settings.description: The moment to count down to, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in your local time (the time can be left out: midnight).

settings.label: Name
settings.description: Shown in the popup and the banner ("Tea", "New year"). Empty: the kind's name.

settings.label: Show a banner
settings.description: A banner beside the dock says the timer ended, also while the dock is hidden; not over a full-screen app (it waits).

settings.label: Play a sound with the banner
settings.description: Windows' Asterisk sound (Settings > System > Sound > More sound settings > Sounds).

settings.label: Timer id
settings.description: Empty: this item's own timer. Items with the same id (on any dock or the desktop) show one shared timer.

settings.label: Style
settings.description: A ring that fills as the time passes with the time inside, the time with a bar under it, or the time alone.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The time's font: a font family installed on this PC. Empty: Segoe UI.

settings.label: Progress colour
settings.description: The ring or bar. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's accent colour.

settings.label: Break colour
settings.description: The ring or bar during a Pomodoro break. Default: green.
